items:
Nestled just steps away from the Gulf of Mexico on Scenic 30A in Dune Allen Beach, "Wave Whisperer" boasts captivating views of Oyster Lake, a rare coastal dune lake, offering exceptional value along 30A. Only 50 yards from a small beach access and in close proximity to the Dune Allen Regional access, this pet-friendly home with a maximum 2-dog rule is a haven for families seeking an affordable yet splendid 30A vacation. Enjoy the convenience of the heated community pool, positioned next to Oyster Lake, and relish easy access to Scenic 30A's renowned bike and walking path.
The bottom floor features a renovated fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and two bedrooms. The primary bedroom offers a king bed and en suite bathroom with a walk-in shower, while the second bedroom includes a queen bed and custom-built twin bunks. The guest bath features a tub/shower combo.
On the second floor, a spacious living area awaits, boasting two seating areas, including a large sectional couch. An additional refrigerator with an ice-maker enhances convenience, accompanied by a sink and microwave for easy snacking. The primary bedroom on this level presents a king bed and en suite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The second bedroom features a queen bed and custom-built adult-sized twin bunks, with the guest bath offering a tub/shower combo. Recently remodeled, all four bathrooms showcase updated features, complemented by new flooring throughout the entire home as of January 2023. Please note that "Wave Whisperer" is a non-smoking rental.

Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Spend some time exploring the area's activities, including birdwatching.
